newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen mixed amid cautious trade.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen mixed amid cautious trade.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to be mixed when trading resumes on Sunday as caution reigns ahead of the approval of the budget, brokers said.

"The market is unlikely to rise ahead of the approval of the proposed budget for next fiscal year," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed. The budget for 1997/98 (July-June) is likely to be approved on Monday by parliament.

Brokers said Singer Bangladesh and Apex Tannery are expected to drop on profit-taking but Monno Ceramic and Delta Life Insurance are seen rising on fresh commitments. The DSE all-share price index closed 12.72 points or 1.14 percent up at 1,123.18 on Thursday.
Friday and Saturday are the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
